build_ssl_transforms_wrapper: build an SSLTransformsWrapper to apply transforms on multimodal input with specified indices
build_augly_transform: build an augly-based transform wrapped by SSLTransformsWrapper for image augmentations
create_ssl_transform_from_config: create an SSLTransformsWrapper instance from a configuration dictionary using from_config
test_transform_with_labels: test transforms that modify or generate labels like ImgRotatePil and ShuffleImgPatches
test_transform_with_copies: test transforms that generate multiple copies of images like ImgReplicatePil and flatten the output
